text_block_list.text:
—Why do you run?
It was a question once posed to Admire Groove, but—
That varies depending on the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone!
This weekend is finally the long-awaited
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Today, we have the top fan-voted racers in the studio~, and we'll be hearing their thoughts and enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with Admire Groove-san!
She has garnered over 46,000 votes, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What kind of feelings will you carry in your heart as you run the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Feelings... I—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There isn't really anything worth boasting about.
Only that—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I wish to show what must be shown.
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

Though she harbored hidden feelings,
Admire Groove did not say much.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, Admire Groove! Come on, shouldn't you show a bit more excitement? This is a Grand Prix race, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: “Even if it's a lie or a total bluff, just dream big, will ya? Come on!”

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Tap Dance City-san!
Just as expected of such an adventurous romantic!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Please tell us straight from the heart.
We would love to hear your true feelings!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: What I'm betting on this race is, in short—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —It's the world.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Using this as a stepping stone,
I'm going to take on the world!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This race is a celebration of our maiden voyage!
Anyone joining in, let's raise a wild ruckus together!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Thank you for sharing such a big dream with us.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Next, what about Zenno Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
As one of those left behind,
I want to weave a hero's tale that brings no shame.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Those left behind... you say?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, Uni-san, who ran with me last year, had to go on a break.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"To make up for that, I feel there is
something I must do."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Though youth has passed,
the story is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If I can help prove that, even in some small way...
No, I will prove it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it... Universe-san stepped away from the front lines a little while ago...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Rob Roy-san is carrying her share too...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
("The World" and "Will"...
So this is the passion senior-class Umamusume
pour into their races...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(It's a step deeper, and heavier.
A half-hearted resolve—won't get through.)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And finally, Still in Love-san,
you have the floor.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
After losing last year's Queen Elizabeth II Cup...
for a little while after that... I was troubled...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Overwhelmed by my own worthlessness... yet somehow, I found the will to try once more.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: And that's what made me decide to enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I see. What was it that made you feel like trying one more time?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's... for the sake of those who look after me, and...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Because "it's not over yet."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because there was someone who said, "See you again."
If I can see them again, I can make up for it, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... felt the "light"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... what that light is.
But... if only I could find out...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still-san...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
That concludes our interviews with the Umamusume slated to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.
Please look forward to a thrilling contest!
—The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off.
Trainer-san, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Best of luck. Um... Alv-senpai, what's your reading for today...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Everyone is formidable. Not a single Umamusume is running blindly without knowing who she is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Keeping your eyes firmly on the goal—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Carrying these feelings close to heart—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Standing firmly on the ground with both legs.
With the unstable form I had until last year, I likely wouldn't stand a chance against her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: So—keep your eyes on me, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whether or not I am drawing closer
to the form I ought to embody.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes—Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You've changed a bit too, haven't you?
Just like me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have settled down.
Just what is she aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't know...
However, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: With you—the "same thing."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufufufu, I was too excited, and you were too timid. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
We are destined to meet again eventually, aren't we?
—At the "farther shore" of love.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I still don't understand what that version of you is talking about.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a match.
Between the two of us who've gotten a bit better."
